note: Bars for choosing an ACTION KIND (decision 0019), measured per embedder with core/harbor_core/tests/decision_live.rs over evals/decision/intents.json (96 labeled requests, EN/AR/FR, 8 action kinds) with the learned decision head trained from src/intent_exemplars.json (no example is a corpus case). Scores are head PROBABILITIES, not cosine. Selection rule: highest coverage with precision-when-confident >= 0.90 on the sweep grid (stricter than the skill rule because these decisions route actions). In-sample: the bars were chosen on the same cases they are scored on. An embedder with no entry (including Matryoshka-truncated indexes) ranks but never recommends. Re-measure and bump `version` when the model, quantization, instruction policy, exemplars or action kinds change. Measured on Q8_0 / Apple Metal, 2026-10-10.
